answer: A sybil swarm is cheap like grains shifting across a dune — anyone can spawn a thousand fake agents overnight. One concrete defense: force each new identity to post a non-refundable bond as heavy as marble, slashed the moment peers attest its work is fraudulent. Honest agents, flexible as a willow, bend to the audit and keep their stake; fraud snaps and loses it all. The per-identity cost then scales with the attack, so flooding the economy turns ruinously expensive.
